notes: Brand Kit Pro v17.7.27: NEW Vector mockup mode — built-in vector drawings (Cup, 3D Box, Bag, Carry-Loop Bottle, Tee, Signboard, Clipped Pattern) drawn inside Illustrator, no photos needed; pick it in Mockup Mode. Includes the 2026-11-26 overhaul: reliable Copy/Paste logo capture across docs, auto-knockout logo recoloring & contrast engine, zero-overflow wrapped AreaText, 4-color smart extractor (Extract Colors now fills primary/secondary/accent/dark) & live template-specific SVG previews. ALL v17.7.26 fixes KEPT: logo upload (Upload Logo button, file logo used everywhere), Send to Muse transmit to Drive BrandKit Inbox, selectable logos, one spacing system (U=12), mockup variety. Brand Kit Pro v17.7.26: (1) LOGO UPLOAD FIXED — big Upload Logo button at the top of the Brand Kit pane (native file dialog), picking a file forces Logo Source to file, and the uploaded logo is now the logo EVERYWHERE (mockup stamps AND logo sections: variations/clearspace/min-size/hero/card/social) — previously the file was ignored (source stayed Illustrator) and the sections only ever used the generated tile. No silent fallbacks: missing/deleted file or locked selection stops Generate with a plain reason. (2) SEND TO MUSE TRANSMITS — the button now POSTs the package (PDF + plan + logo + manifest + brief) to the license server (brandkit_upload) which saves it to Drive folder 'Design360n BrandKit Inbox'; clear success/failure status, local package always kept. (3) SELECTABLE LOGOS, ONE SPACING SYSTEM (U=12), MOCKUP VARIETY (18 different realistic photos) from v17.7.25. Logo-on-mockup rules unchanged: uniform scale, 15% clearspace, 64px/20mm min-size floor, variant rule, tint under logo. Mockups download at runtime only; live manifest keeps the full 22-file list (PNGs excluded: updater is text-only).
